name: wallet-unlock-2828
description: What /wallet/unlock does when the wallet's secret file cannot be read (ergoplatform/ergo#2828): one node, wallet initialized from /wallet/init and locked, its secret file moved out of the keystore directory, the unlock timed, the file moved back and the wallet unlocked again without a node restart, then the node restarted and unlocked once more. pass = an error answer within 10 s, the wallet still initialized and locked, unlocked once the file is back, and initialized and unlocked after the restart.
